query: What drives praise and complaints in Amazon reviews?

per_column.name: praise_signal_count
per_column.rationale: Counts the positive-sentiment drivers present in a review; this is a constitutive part (the praise side) of the driver concept.

per_column.name: complaint_signal_count
per_column.rationale: Counts the negative-sentiment drivers; the complaint side is a constitutive aspect of the concept.

per_column.name: dominant_driver
per_column.rationale: A summary label (praise_driven/complaint_driven/mixed/neutral) that recombines the two count facets into a single verdict about the whole; it restates the concept rather than isolating a distinct part.

per_column.name: mentioned_aspects
per_column.rationale: Identifies WHICH product aspects (quality, value, shipping, service, performance...) the praise/complaints are about; these are the substantive thematic parts of what drives sentiment.

per_column.name: review_length_bucket
per_column.rationale: A mechanical property of the text (length); not an aspect OF what drives praise or complaint.

per_column.name: exclamation_count
per_column.rationale: A stylistic intensity signal that may correlate with strength of sentiment but is not itself a constitutive part of the driver concept.

per_column.name: has_comparison
per_column.rationale: Whether the review compares products is a rhetorical feature that may predict, but does not constitute, a praise/complaint driver.

per_column.name: repeat_purchase_signal
per_column.rationale: Indicates loyalty behavior that may cause or correlate with praise but is an external behavioral signal, not a facet of the driver itself.

judge.rationale: Only three columns are true meronymic facets: the praise side, the complaint side, and the thematic aspects being praised/complained about. However mutual exclusivity is weakened because dominant_driver overlaps entirely with the two signal-count columns (it is derived from them) and mentioned_aspects also implicitly re-encodes valence, so the polarity and aspect axes partly bleed together. Exhaustiveness is moderate: praise, complaint, and topical aspects cover the core, but constitutive facets like the specific reason/attribute cause, emotional intensity as a genuine facet, and expectation-vs-outcome are only partially represented, and much of the set (length, exclamations, comparisons, repeat-purchase) consists of external predictors and stylistic features rather than parts of the concept.
